data.narrative:
StoreDot is a Series E climate and energy company that has raised $206.5M to date. The valuation assessment draws from a comp universe of 1 public peer (Linamar, ticker LNZA) and 8 private peers in the climate & energy sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

The stage-progression method is applicable and yields a $289M implied valuation, derived by applying a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E-to-next-stage progression to the $206M total raised proxy. A peer-median approach is not applicable; while 8 same-sector peers exist, the dataset contains insufficient depth in same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables (only 1 same-stage peer identified), falling short of the minimum 3 datapoints required for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material noise given the narrow peer set within narrower filters.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $246M (low) to $332M (high), with a median of $289M. This range reflects conservative application of stage-progression mechanics alone. Key uncertainties include the thinness of the direct comparables set within StoreDot's specific stage and category, the reliance on total capital raised as a proxy absent a current post-money valuation, and the typical variance in step-up multiples across market conditions. Additional clarity on recent fundraising terms and comparable transaction multiples would narrow this range materially.
